The 'Ground-track shift per orbit' row is correct, but the 60 km swath need of five passes is not reconciled with weekly full-reef coverage across ~2,300 km."},{"where":"Project Plan / Figure 1","issue":"Gantt shows STK Simulations active in Week 10, but text states final design ends Week 9 and Week 10 has no new design work."},{"where":"Mission Concept","issue":"'Oceans have become 30 percent more acidic' is imprecise; the acidity rise is about 30% in hydrogen-ion concentration (pH drop ~0.1)."},{"where":"Preliminary Progress","issue":"Launch vehicle, trajectory and launch site work (Launch Specifics) is not yet addressed, limiting R2 coverage of launch."}],"overall":"A strong, well-structured Part 1 report with a clear, user-linked mission concept, a risk-aware Gantt plan, and verified orbit calculations that surface a real coverage trade-off.
